newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil monetary base posts most growth since Dec.
newsitem.headline: Brazil monetary base posts most growth since Dec.

text.p: Brazil's monetary base expanded by an estimated 5.0 billion reais in September, its biggest monthly expansion since December when it grew by 6.1 billion reais, local newspaper Gazeta Mercantil said.
The paper, which did not cite a source, said September's expansion was the result of a last-minute dash by banks to the rediscount rate and injections of resources by the Central Bank.
The two factors offset a net outflow of foreign currency totalling about $1.0 billion, the largest outflow since June 1995, it said.
The monetary base stood at 20.5 billion reais at the end of September, it added.
